memory_update.text: The purest ABF-film, copper-bonding chemistry, and FC-BGA substrate chokepoints cited in the evidence are mostly outside clean US common-stock listings; US-listed exposure is mostly second-order through packaging capacity, chemistry/equipment, metrology, and yield software.

MKSI should remain on the advanced-packaging substrates/materials watchlist because Atotech provides package-substrate and semiconductor wet-process/plating/surface-treatment technologies, making it one of the more direct US-listed process-chemistry proxies.

AMKR is a capacity and integration proxy rather than a substrate/material supplier; it should be tracked for AI advanced packaging revenue, domestic packaging ramp execution, customer concentration, and substrate/material procurement risk.

PDFS is a weaker but potentially underappreciated software/data candidate; it needs evidence that advanced packaging, OSAT, assembly, and test analytics are driving durable growth rather than generic semiconductor software demand.
Future Layer 2 work should separate four distinct public-market mappings: physical substrate makers, ABF/surface-chemistry suppliers, packaging-capacity integrators, and yield-enablement vendors.

node: Advanced packaging substrates, ABF-style insulating materials, and copper-bonding chemistry
summary: This Layer 1B pass expands the US-listed universe around the substrate/materials layer below AI accelerators and HBM-heavy packages. The purest substrate/material chokepoints cited in the input evidence are mostly non-US-listed or not cleanly investable as US AI substrate plays: Ajinomoto for ABF-style insulating film, MEC for copper-bonding surface chemistry, and Asian substrate makers such as Ibiden, Unimicron, Kinsus, AT&S, and Shinko. For US listings, the most plausible mappings are therefore second-order: outsourced advanced packaging capacity, copper/plating/package-substrate process chemistry and equipment, advanced-packaging inspection/metrology, and yield/data orchestration. No buy/sell view is implied.
